subject: SIG Q&A scheduling + artifact roster alignment
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@everfield.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@everfield.com, Priya Sethi <priya.s@everfield.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: SIG Q&A and artifact roster request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. We need to schedule a SIG-style Q&A to validate a handful of controls for an internal audit next month. Can your team run a 45-minute session next week? Our preferred windows: Mon 8/18 10:00-12:00 PT or Wed 8/20 14:00-16:00 PT.

Separately: please share an "artifact roster" listing owners and the approximate location of each artifact (logs, network diagram, configuration snapshots, CAIQ sections, etc.). Also, we'll want a redacted log sample (app + auth) for scope verification.

Let me know which slot works and who on your side will own the artifacts so we can loop in our reviewers.

Regards,
Tom Hayes
Head of IT Audit | Everfield Health
security@everfield.com

Subject: Re: SIG Q&A and artifact roster request

Hi Tom — thanks for the note. We can do a 45‑minute sync. Wed 8/20 14:00 PT works best for our team; I've penciled that in but will wait for your confirmation.

Per your artifact roster request, attached is a proposed roster (spreadsheet) with suggested owners and document locations — it's a working draft so we can adjust. We'll also prepare a redacted app/auth log sample and a short retention matrix to explain windows and access controls.

Planned owners from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole — CAIQ/SIG questionnaire and control mappings
- Soojin Lee — network diagram and configuration snapshots
- David Kim — log extraction + redaction (app/auth)

Action: Please confirm Wed 8/20 14:00 PT and whether Everfield prefers the log sample in plaintext (gz) or a CSV extract.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
Attachment: artifact_roster_proposed.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Everfield SIG prep — artifact ownership + ask list

Team — forwarding Everfield's request and my reply. Quick alignment before the call:

Please grab the bullet items below and confirm you can produce the artifacts by Tue EOD so we have time to redact and package.

Deliverables and owners (proposed):
- CAIQ subset + control crosswalk — Marissa
- Network diagram (layered) + config snapshots — Soojin
- App + auth log sample (redacted) — David
- Retention matrix + policies short doc — Kimberly (I'll assemble with inputs)

Redaction rules: remove IPs and user PII; keep timestamps and event types. David — can you confirm the extraction format (gz vs CSV) and approximate file size?

I'll also prepare a 10-minute runbook slide so we can walk reviewers through where artifacts live.

Thanks — K.

From: david_kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Everfield SIG prep — artifact ownership + ask list

Confirmed — I'll own the log sample. A few notes:
- Source: app (auth + session events) + frontend error logs.
- Retention baseline: 90 days for token/event logs; we can supply a 30/90/365 matrix for the call.
- Redaction: will remove IPv4/IPv6, full UUIDs, and any email addresses; will keep timestamps and event names.
- Preferred delivery: gzip of newline-delimited JSON (ndjson.gz). If Everfield prefers CSV, I can convert but it increases size.

I will stage a redacted sample ~5MB (ndjson.gz) and a short extraction note by Tue 8/19 EOD. If anyone needs additional fields (trace ids, user agent), let me know.

-David
David Kim
SRE — Inference Platform | Redwood Inference
Attachment: log_sample_2025-07_redacted.ndjson.gz (archive, ~5MB)

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@everfield.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@everfield.com>, security_ops@everfield.com
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Q&A and artifact roster request

Thanks — Wed 8/20 14:00 PT confirmed. We consent to recording the session for our audit team.

For the artifacts we'll prioritize: CAIQ responses (focused on data handling and key management), SIG control crosswalk, the network diagram, and the redacted log sample. Delivery preference: drive link to a zipped bundle and a brief manifest PDF listing files and owners.

We'll circulate our reviewers (Priya and a member of the audit team) ahead of the call. See you Wednesday.

Tom
Head of IT Audit | Everfield Health
